title: 第9章 大壮医生你快帮人家治治吧~~~
novel_title: 神医小傻驴的乡村女人
content_zh:
“没兴趣！”李大壮却一句话拒绝了张振生的提议。

    “大壮！！”

    李家二老异口同声的叫了一声，张桂芬更是急切的扯着李大壮的袖子，低声道：“你个傻小子，这多好的工作啊，听妈的，赶紧应下来！”

    “妈，你儿子已经不是以前的那个李大壮了，别说县医院了，就算是省立医院的工作，我也看不上眼！”

    “你！你这个混小子！咋还学会说大话了！？”张桂芬气的直瞪眼。

    “妈，我没说大话，刚才我给爸接手指的时候，你也看到了，我有这样的本事，何愁没前途？这种工作只会绑住我，让我无法施展！”

    “桂芬，大壮说的有道理，听大壮的！”

    李守义发了话，张桂芬虽然不甘心，却也只能生气的瞪了儿子一眼，就不再说话了。

    “行了，你的孝心，我心领了，看在你愿赌服输的份儿上，我也不难为你了，起来吧！”

    李大壮淡淡的看着林振生。

    “谢谢师父！”林振生擦了把汗，心里刚松了口气，就听见李大壮继续说：“哎！瞎叫啥呢？你想拜我为师，我可没答应！”

    “呃，您……”

    “我可不收你这么资质平庸的徒弟！”李大壮没好气的说。

    林振生傻眼了，合着自己虽然忍辱跪下了，却还是没结交上这位未来之龙？

    “那个，您不想收我也行，我能不能加您个联系方式，以后要是有个什么病痛，能找您去看吗？”林振生只能退而求其次。

    “行啊！不过我的诊费可不便宜！”

    “没问题，没问题，您本事大，诊费贵也是应该的！”林振生双手捧着手机，恭敬的加上了李大壮的微信。

    “帅哥，能不能加一下我的微信，我最近腰下面那个位置，总是不舒服，你帮我看看行吗~~”

    “还有我，我~我胸口闷，喘不上气来，你能给我扎几针吗？”
content_en:
Lin Wanhe's shy yet urgent voice made Li Dazhuang come back to his senses. He cleared his throat: "Don't worry, we're coming soon!"

    As soon as he finished speaking, Li Dazhuang began to give Lin Wanhe massage therapy.

    The strange and wonderful touch made both of them stunned!

    Especially Lin Wanhe, Li Dazhuang's hands had a scalding temperature, and there were also some abrasive calluses, which were rough but irritating. After just treating them, Lin Wanhe couldn't help but scream out: "Oh~~good~~so exciting~~~"

    "Doctor Lin, please bear with me. People may hear me and think I did something to you." Li Dazhuang deliberately teased.

    Lin Wanhe was so frightened that she covered her mouth, but as Li Dazhuang's massage became more and more precise and powerful, she couldn't help it anymore and could only moan softly from between her fingers.

    In fact, Li Dazhuang also felt uncomfortable...

    Fortunately, this wonderful yet irritating feeling did not last long, and Li Dazhuang stopped.

    "It's time for acupuncture!"

    "Ah~ no more? But I still want it~~" Lin Wanhe was like a young woman who was dissatisfied with her desires, her beautiful eyes gleaming with desire.

    "Dr. Lin, I have my own treatment rhythm. You'd better not mess with it at will." Li Dazhuang said seriously. In fact, he was about to explode. It was just that the treatment bed was shielding him and not exposing him.

    Lin Wanhe believed it, and immediately blushed with shame for his behavior. He apologized quickly and gasped: "Yes~ I'm sorry, I~ I don't know what's going on. I'm not like this usually!"

    "Understood, my massage technique is quite special. It is mixed with my own breath, which will make people feel very comfortable. It is normal that you want it again." Li Dazhuang explained very considerately.

    Lin Wanhe breathed a sigh of relief, as long as Dr. Da Zhuang doesn't dislike him for not respecting himself.

    Unknowingly, Lin Wanhe was already very concerned about what this man whom he had just met for the first time thought of him!

    Li Dazhuang didn't know the thoughts of Lin Wanhe's women, but he flew his fingers, gathered his true energy on the silver needle, and inserted it into the acupuncture points around Lin Wanhe's affected area!

    Lin Wanhe instinctively shivered, but the expected pain did not appear. Instead, there was a feeling of relief that was similar to massage. Wherever the silver needle hit the flesh, there seemed to be a thin stream, pouring into the skin, gathering at the bottom of the affected area, and finally rushed to the top of the affected area, and gradually spread to the surroundings!

    "Oh... so numb... so comfortable..."
title_en: Chapter 10 Da Zhuang~~I still want it~~
